records.scope: Complete necessary component enumeration, not SRG completion.

all_colour_E3_filter.scope:
Exclude every three-edge rectangle based at ANY point of the root line.

For a same-colour matching edge u-v in a coloured component of N(L),
take its four neighbours in the other two colours. They are the four
rectangle corners at that point of L, between L and the line through u-v.
Exactly three induced edges violate the universal no-P4 rectangle theorem.
This is a necessary local filter, independent of the Gram and prism budget.

additional_necessary_condition:
Apply the no-P4 rectangle theorem after rotating the root inside a line.

In a coloured cubic component of N(L), every colour induces a matching.
Let (u,v,w) be a triangle using the three colours, and let (u',v',w') be
their same-colour mates. Their induced graph cannot have exactly two
edges. For example u'~v',u'~w',v'!~w' gives, rooted at u, a forbidden
P4 rectangle on the two other points of L together with v',w'.

This is stronger than checking the rectangles at the original root only.
It uses no chosen completion and applies to every Conway line component.
